What data the app processes and where it is stored.
LogiQ is a school learning app. We collect only what is needed for it to work, and use no advertising or tracking.
1. If you do not connect to a teacher
Everything stays on this device only (in the browser storage):
the name or nickname, grade and class you entered
your results: solved tasks, stars, points, badges, stickers, streak
settings (sound, animations, large text, theme, avatar)
None of it is sent to a server. You can delete it by clearing the site data in your browser settings.
2. If you connect to a teacher with a class code
The following is sent to the server (Cloudflare, database in Europe):
nickname or first name and grade
a summary of results: stars, points, number of tasks, streak, rank, strong and weak topics, the last 15 tasks
progress on tasks assigned by the teacher
If you send a report with the 💬 button, the name (if you enter one), the message text and technical details are sent: page, task title, grade, class, app version and device type.
We do not send surname, address, e-mail, phone, location or photos. Please do not put a surname in the nickname.
The data is visible to your class teacher, the app administrator and a parent who has your parent code (read-only). It is not public.
teacher e-mail and password (stored only as a salted hash)
no advertising, no tracking or analytics, no third-party cookies
we do not sell or share data with third parties
read-aloud uses the device voice, nothing is sent

Whenever you connect, the hosting providers (GitHub, Cloudflare) see the device IP address in normal operating logs. The server remembers the IP for a few minutes only to protect against abuse (login attempt limit).
Disconnecting in Profile stops sending new data. Data already on the server is deleted by the teacher or administrator on request (a pupil or parent can ask the teacher).
